investigations.name: Stadtwerke Rostock AG
investigations.evidenceSummary: Fresh m8mit operator inventory exposes sampled AC 22 kW guest tuple at 0.49 EUR/kWh + 1.49 EUR Direct-Pay + 0.10 EUR/min after 4h. Current first-party Stadtwerke Rostock page confirms multiple access channels (OSTSEE-STROM MOBIL QR/m8mit, RFID, E-Charging+, SMS) but does not publish a numeric anonymous guest tariff. A fresh HPC 150 kW direct-payment surface reports 0.59 EUR/kWh + 0.10 EUR/min after 90 min, so the historical B7 contradictory-sources blocker remains material.
investigations.exactGap: Need authoritative anonymous_ad_hoc tariff matrix binding AC/DC/HPC classes and fee thresholds to current Stadtwerke Rostock EVSEs, or exhaustive m8mit/direct checkout coverage. Do not substitute the OSTSEE-STROM MOBIL contract tariff (0.38 AC / 0.48 DC + monthly fee) for guest pricing.
